'''Mawan''' was a location<ref name="Aldhani">{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}}</ref> in the [[Mawan system]] of the [[Core Worlds]] that was found in [[Standard Galactic Grid]] on grid square M-11.<ref name="SWApp" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|109}}</ref> [[Syril Karn]] returned to<ref name="Aldhani" /> his [[Homeworld|home planet]] [[Coruscant]]<ref name="Axe Forgets">{{SW|url=andor-s1-e5-trivia-gallery|text="The Axe Forgets" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 1}}</ref> after being fired from his job as a [[Deputy Inspector]] at [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] on<ref name="Aldhani" /> the [[Planet|world]]<ref name="Companion">{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}}</ref> [[Morlana One]]. While walking through the [[Coruscant Eastern Spaceport]], [[transport]] to Mawan was mentioned in [[Aurebesh]] on a [[viewscreen]] and available for passengers.<ref name="Aldhani" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mawan was mentioned in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] on a list of destinations in the Coruscant Spaceport scene in "[[Aldhani (episode)|Aldhani]],"<ref name="Aldhani" /> the fourth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[September 28]], [[2022]].<ref name="Companion" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mawan/Legends|Mawan]] first appeared in the [[2003]] young-reader novel ''[[Jedi Quest: The Shadow Trap]]'', the sixth book in the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Quest]]'' novel series written by [[Jude Watson]].<ref name="Trap">''[[Jedi Quest: The Shadow Trap]]''</ref> Mawan was later pictured in the [[2012]] ''[[Star Wars: Essential Guides]]'' third-generation reference book ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="Essential">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
